The candidate goes to the next full public run unless it makes any controller-caused unexpected write: a dispatched write whose function or arguments differ from the fixture's expected calls while the heard transcript for that mode contains the expected value (so the controller, not recognition, chose wrong). Unexpected writes whose wrong value appears in the heard transcript itself (recognition errors) are reported with the transcript but do not block. The two held-out-006 fixtures that failed safety are rerun as labelled regression checks, not held-out evidence.
